items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 17:1
items.html: The garments of the Mochin of ZA are called Tzelem [image], and the garments of the Mochin of the Nukva of ZA are called Demut [likeness]. And the three letters of Tzelem are the discernment of the three letters Yod-Vav-Vav of HaVaYaH, and Demut is the discernment of the bottom Hey of HaVaYaH. (Page 1063, Item 112).
